title: Add reporting review guidance and evaluation fixtures
summary: Nine reporting rules and guidance articles have been added to the BCQuality knowledge base covering report variable clearing, CurrReport control flow, report extensions, table view narrowing, and request page cancellation.
key_points: Added nine new reporting rules addressing control-flow behavior and data handling in reports
Included bad and good AL code samples for each rule to guide developers
Created a dedicated reporting review skill with evidence-based review conditions to minimize false positives
Integrated new rules into the main AL code review skill and evaluation fixtures
Rules focus on preventing incorrect output, unintended side effects, and lost database changes
quote: This PR adds dedicated review coverage for AL reporting scenarios that were not previously represented in the BCQuality knowledge base.
